capabilities: Import Goodreads CSV exports as Markdown notes via file picker, vault selection, or drag and drop
Fetch book cover images and Markdown-converted synopses from Goodreads pages
Build customizable YAML frontmatter with renameable keys, ordering, formatting styles, and template variables
Update, overwrite, or skip existing notes while preserving reading notes, matched by Goodreads id or filename
Filter imports by shelf and exclude specific shelves from frontmatter
extras: The README duplicates the Features and Template Variables sections verbatim; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: I used to use Booksidian, but the end of the RSS feed made it impossible
motivation: The author built it because the end of the Goodreads RSS feed made it impossible to keep reading notes in sync with Goodreads, replacing a Booksidian-based workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Goodreads library export into book notes, and the shutdown of the Goodreads RSS feed broke prior sync workflows.
